rationale.quality-debt: Centers maintainability, comprehension, documentation, and technical-debt harms in AI code.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI accelerates output while rigorous review consumes developer productivity.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Specifies linting, static analysis, documentation validation, tests, and threshold gates.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Requires dual review, explicit comprehension confirmation, and approval before integration.
rationale.oversight-explanation: EEL supplies rationale, decision trees, alternatives, and generation context.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Tags AI-origin sections and persistently preserves prompts, constraints, and metadata.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes productivity and democratization claims that omit maintenance burdens.
rationale.framework: VIBE4M is a reusable multilayer pipeline architecture for maintainability governance.
rationale.design-only: Framework is explicitly unimplemented; validation remains proposed future work.
rationale.assistive: Covers human-initiated snippet and block-level AI coding assistance.
rationale.agentic: Vibe coding delegates complete applications and iterative multi-step development.
rationale.metrics: Defines metrics measuring quality and comprehensibility of AI-generated code.
rationale.non-developer: Substantively analyzes non-developers' inability to maintain generated applications.
rationale.risk-quality: Focal analysis and mitigations address quality and code comprehensibility harms.
rationale.risk-security: Dedicated vulnerability analysis recommends static analysis and automated penetration testing.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Analyzes unverified acceptance and requires developers to confirm comprehension.
